title: Hospitality Business Management
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of discussions/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of hospitality, hotel business, and tourism accommodation, and analyze the characteristics of hotel business activities.
Analyze marketing activities and marketing mix strategies in the hospitality industry.
Understand and apply human resource management principles in the hospitality sector.
Manage operations, including procurement and quality service management, in the hospitality industry.
Control and audit business activities, optimize revenue, and analyze financial performance in the hospitality sector.
Organize and effectively utilize input resources in hotel business operations.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze and explain real-world situations in the hospitality business.
Handle situations that arise during the operation and management of hotel businesses in Vietnam and globally.
Analyze and propose organizational management models for hotel businesses.
Evaluate the impact of hotel business activities on the economy, environment, and society.
